narrative:
Capital expenditure of about GBP 245M a year funds hospitals and clinics (diagnostics, theatres, new sites), care home refurbishment and fire safety, dental practice expansion, digital health and the Blua platform, and core insurance and finance platforms.

The investment is self-funded: cash generated is reinvested in more and better care, in line with Bupa's model of having no shareholders. Every programme carries its own depreciation profile and can be linked to its capital requirement in the Solvency II module before approval.

signals.title: King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals join UK Health Services
signals.excerpt: UK Health Services revenue grew on higher volumes and the two acquisitions; underlying profit reduced as Bupa invests for growth.

signals.title: Group Solvency II coverage 189%
signals.excerpt: Own funds £6.8bn against an SCR of £3.6bn — above the 140–170% working range; a 2% worse loss ratio would reduce coverage to 182%.
